judgment_refs.phrase: unprotected hose of a fire department
judgment_refs.note: Department affiliation, asset identity and all protection arrangements need independent inventory and pixels.

judgment_refs.phrase: highway or private way or place for use at any fire or alarm of fire or practice runs
judgment_refs.note: Way dedication/public access, actual route placement and department use purpose need separate sources.
Original vehicle footprint and motion measure passage; no invented legal overlap or speed cutoff.

judgment_refs.phrase: consent of the fire department official in command
judgment_refs.note: Official identity/status and communication content, timing and scope need source review; no gesture inference.

sweep_specs.rationale: Synthetic diagnostics preserve source joins while original hose status, protection and command authority remain open.
missing_inputs: Independent original way, hose and command sources.
